- **What was wrong:** autotrade stamped each new position's opened_at_ts with the cycle's last bar. Since the loop moved to daily bars (about 2026-09-22) that bar is the PREVIOUS session's - the price files exclude the session in progress - so every entry was dated one session early, bars_held counted one extra session, and the 20-session cap would fire on D+19. Found 2026-10-03 on 5 of the 7 open positions (IWM, MDY, SCHD, SCHW, VZ).
- **Correction:** autotrade._entry_stamp: a new position is stamped with the broker's clock (UTC) when the cycle read it, otherwise this machine's UTC time. The 5 open positions were re-dated to the time of their own audit-log entry events by scripts/repair_entry_stamps.py --apply (state backed up to data/autotrade-state.backup-before-REM-0010.json; a state_repair event logged). Their caps move one session later: VZ 10-20, IWM 10-21, SCHD 10-21, MDY 10-22, SCHW 10-29; CVS and UNP were already correct (10-19).
- **Affects:** LIVE money path - holding-cap timing only. No strategy rule, parameter, universe or limit changed.
